2-1-1.q: True or false: God made us with a body and a soul. We can think, choose and love. This makes us different from the animals.
Which word fits? “Every person is made like God: able to think, choose and love.”
2-1-1.why: image of God: Every person is made like God: able to think, choose and love.

2-1-1.q: Which word fits? “The spiritual part of a person that lives forever and cannot be seen.”
2-1-1.why: soul: The spiritual part of a person that lives forever and cannot be seen.

2-1-1.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Made in God’s image” teaches? “He taught that a happy heart honors God.”
2-1-1.why: Francis de Sales: he taught that a happy heart honors God.

2-1-1.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Made in God’s image”?
2-1-1.why: Genesis 1:26-27 is the passage for this lesson.

2-1-2.q: True or false: God gave us free will. We can choose good or evil. When we choose good, we grow in goodness.
Which word fits? “The gift to choose for ourselves, and so to love or not to love.”
2-1-2.why: free will: The gift to choose for ourselves, and so to love or not to love.

2-1-2.q: Which word fits? “The inner voice of judgment that helps us know right from wrong.”
2-1-2.why: conscience: The inner voice of judgment that helps us know right from wrong.

2-1-2.q: Catechism 1730: “God created man a rational being, conferring on him the _____ of a person who can initiate and control his own actions.”
2-1-2.why: CCC 1730: “God created man a rational being, conferring on him the dignity of a person who can initiate and control his own actions.”

2-1-2.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Free to choose” teaches? “He chose to give up his inheritance to serve God.”
2-1-2.why: Aloysius Gonzaga: he chose to give up his inheritance to serve God.

2-1-2.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Free to choose”?
2-1-2.why: Deuteronomy 30:15-20 is the passage for this lesson.

2-1-3.q: True or false: Sin hurts our friendship with God and others. God never stops loving us. He sent Jesus to save us.
Which word fits? “Choosing to do or say something that goes against God’s love and his law.”
2-1-3.why: sin: Choosing to do or say something that goes against God’s love and his law.

2-1-3.q: Which word fits? “Love that forgives and helps those who are suffering or in need.”
2-1-3.why: mercy: Love that forgives and helps those who are suffering or in need.

2-1-3.q: Catechism 1846: “"You shall call his name Jesus, for he will save his people from their sins." The same is true of the _____, the sacrament of redemption:”
2-1-3.why: CCC 1846: “"You shall call his name Jesus, for he will save his people from their sins." The same is true of the Eucharist, the sacrament of redemption:”

2-1-3.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Sin hurts and God heals” teaches? “The good thief who was welcomed into paradise.”
2-1-3.why: Dismas: the good thief who was welcomed into paradise.

2-1-3.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Sin hurts and God heals”?
2-1-3.why: Luke 15:11-32 is the passage for this lesson.

2-2-1.q: True or false: Jesus is the Good Shepherd who knows us and cares for us. He leads us to the Father.
Which word fits? “A follower and learner of Jesus.”
2-2-1.why: disciple: A follower and learner of Jesus.

2-2-1.q: Catechism 2665: “The _____ of the Church, nourished by the Word of God and the celebration of the liturgy, teaches us to pray to the Lord Jesus.”
2-2-1.why: CCC 2665: “The prayer of the Church, nourished by the Word of God and the celebration of the liturgy, teaches us to pray to the Lord Jesus.”

2-2-1.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “The Good Shepherd” teaches? “A shepherd boy before he was a missionary.”
2-2-1.why: Patrick: a shepherd boy before he was a missionary.

2-2-1.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “The Good Shepherd”?
2-2-1.why: John 10:11-16 is the passage for this lesson.

2-2-2.q: True or false: Jesus told stories to help us know God’s kingdom. The mustard seed and the lost sheep show God’s love.
Which word fits? “A short story Jesus told to teach about the kingdom of God.”
2-2-2.why: parable: A short story Jesus told to teach about the kingdom of God.

2-2-2.q: Which word fits? “God’s loving rule, which Jesus began and which will be complete in heaven.”
2-2-2.why: kingdom of God: God’s loving rule, which Jesus began and which will be complete in heaven.

2-2-2.q: Catechism 546: “One must enter the kingdom, that is, become a _____ of Christ, in order to "know the secrets of the kingdom of heaven".”
2-2-2.why: CCC 546: “One must enter the kingdom, that is, become a disciple of Christ, in order to "know the secrets of the kingdom of heaven".”

2-2-2.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Parables of the kingdom” teaches? “He treated every creature as a gift.”
2-2-2.why: Francis of Assisi: he treated every creature as a gift.

2-2-2.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Parables of the kingdom”?
2-2-2.why: Luke 15:1-7 is the passage for this lesson.

2-2-3.q: True or false: Jesus gave us eight ways to be happy. Following them leads us to God.
Which word fits? “Jesus’ eight sayings on the path to true happiness.”
2-2-3.why: Beatitudes: Jesus’ eight sayings on the path to true happiness.

2-2-3.q: Catechism 1716: “the _____ fulfill the promises by ordering them no longer merely to the possession of a territory, but to the Kingdom of heaven:”
2-2-3.why: CCC 1716: “the Beatitudes fulfill the promises by ordering them no longer merely to the possession of a territory, but to the Kingdom of heaven:”

2-2-3.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “The Beatitudes” teaches? “They lived poverty of spirit.”
2-2-3.why: Francis and Clare of Assisi: they lived poverty of spirit.

2-2-3.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “The Beatitudes”?
2-2-3.why: Matthew 5:1-12 is the passage for this lesson.

2-3-1.q: True or false: Conscience helps us know right from wrong. We should listen to it and form it with the Church’s teaching.
Which word fits? “The inner voice of judgment that helps us know right from wrong.”
2-3-1.why: conscience: The inner voice of judgment that helps us know right from wrong.

2-3-1.q: Catechism 1776: “"Deep within his _____ man discovers a law which he has not laid upon himself but which he must obey.”
2-3-1.why: CCC 1776: “"Deep within his conscience man discovers a law which he has not laid upon himself but which he must obey.”

2-3-1.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Conscience: our inner guide” teaches? “He followed his conscience.”
2-3-1.why: Thomas More: he followed his conscience.

2-3-1.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Conscience: our inner guide”?
2-3-1.why: Romans 2:14-15 is the passage for this lesson.

2-3-2.q: True or false: Before Confession we think about what we did and ask God for help. We remember: did I love God, my family and others?
Which word fits? “Choosing to do or say something that goes against God’s love and his law.”
2-3-2.why: sin: Choosing to do or say something that goes against God’s love and his law.

2-3-2.q: Which word fits? “Sorrow for sin and a decision not to sin again.”
2-3-2.why: contrition: Sorrow for sin and a decision not to sin again.

2-3-2.q: Catechism 1454: “The reception of this sacrament ought to be prepared for by an examination of _____ made in the light of the Word of God.”
2-3-2.why: CCC 1454: “The reception of this sacrament ought to be prepared for by an examination of conscience made in the light of the Word of God.”

2-3-2.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Examining our hearts” teaches? “He taught an evening examen.”
2-3-2.why: Ignatius of Loyola: he taught an evening examen.

2-3-2.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Examining our hearts”?
2-3-2.why: Psalm 139:23-24 is the passage for this lesson.

2-3-3.q: True or false: We tell our sins to a priest. He gives us a penance and forgives us in Jesus’ name. We feel God’s peace.
Which word fits? “The sacrament of Confession, in which God forgives our sins through the priest.”
2-3-3.why: Reconciliation: The sacrament of Confession, in which God forgives our sins through the priest.

2-3-3.q: Which word fits? “The words by which the priest, in Jesus’ name, forgives sins.”
2-3-3.why: absolution: The words by which the priest, in Jesus’ name, forgives sins.

2-3-3.q: Catechism 1440: “For this reason conversion entails both God's forgiveness and _____ with the Church, which are expressed and accomplished liturgically by the sacrament of Penance and Reconciliation.”
2-3-3.why: CCC 1440: “For this reason conversion entails both God's forgiveness and reconciliation with the Church, which are expressed and accomplished liturgically by the sacrament of Penance and Reconciliation.”

2-3-3.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “The sacrament of Reconciliation” teaches? “He heard confessions for hours.”
2-3-3.why: Padre Pio: he heard confessions for hours.

2-3-3.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “The sacrament of Reconciliation”?
2-3-3.why: John 20:21-23 is the passage for this lesson.

2-4-1.q: True or false: Jesus gave us the Eucharist at the Last Supper. He changed bread and wine into his Body and Blood.
Which word fits? “The sacrament of Jesus’ Body and Blood, given to us under the appearances of bread and wine.”
2-4-1.why: Eucharist: The sacrament of Jesus’ Body and Blood, given to us under the appearances of bread and wine.

2-4-1.q: Which word fits? “A gift offered to God; Jesus offered himself once for all on the cross.”
2-4-1.why: sacrifice: A gift offered to God; Jesus offered himself once for all on the cross.

2-4-1.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “The Last Supper” teaches? “Wrote hymns to the Eucharist.”
2-4-1.why: Thomas Aquinas: wrote hymns to the Eucharist.

2-4-1.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “The Last Supper”?
2-4-1.why: Luke 22:14-20 is the passage for this lesson.

2-4-2.q: True or false: After the priest says the words, bread and wine become Jesus. We call this the Real Presence.
Which word fits? “Jesus is truly, fully present in the Eucharist: body, blood, soul and divinity.”
2-4-2.why: Real Presence: Jesus is truly, fully present in the Eucharist: body, blood, soul and divinity.

2-4-2.q: Which word fits? “The change of the whole substance of bread and wine into Christ’s Body and Blood.”
2-4-2.why: transubstantiation: The change of the whole substance of bread and wine into Christ’s Body and Blood.

2-4-2.q: Catechism 1376: “This change the holy Catholic Church has fittingly and properly called _____."”
2-4-2.why: CCC 1376: “This change the holy Catholic Church has fittingly and properly called transubstantiation."”

2-4-2.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Jesus is truly present” teaches? “He loved the Eucharist.”
2-4-2.why: Carlo Acutis: he loved the Eucharist.

2-4-2.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Jesus is truly present”?
2-4-2.why: John 6:51-58 is the passage for this lesson.

2-4-3.q: True or false: The Mass has four parts: gathering, God’s word, the Eucharist and sending forth.
Which word fits? “The Church’s highest prayer, in which Jesus’ sacrifice is made present and we receive him.”
2-4-3.why: Mass: The Church’s highest prayer, in which Jesus’ sacrifice is made present and we receive him.

2-4-3.q: Which word fits? “The Church’s public worship.”
Catechism 1346: “The _____ of the Eucharist unfolds according to a fundamental structure which has been preserved throughout the centuries down to our own day.”
2-4-3.why: CCC 1346: “The liturgy of the Eucharist unfolds according to a fundamental structure which has been preserved throughout the centuries down to our own day.”

2-4-3.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “The parts of the Mass” teaches? “He encouraged frequent Communion for children.”
2-4-3.why: Pope Pius X: he encouraged frequent Communion for children.

2-4-3.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “The parts of the Mass”?
2-4-3.why: Luke 24:13-35 is the passage for this lesson.

2-5-1.q: True or false: Mary said yes to God’s plan. We ask her to help us say yes. She is our mother.
Which word fits? “The Mother of Jesus and so Mother of God; our mother in faith.”
2-5-1.why: Mary: The Mother of Jesus and so Mother of God; our mother in faith.

2-5-1.q: Which word fits? “Mary’s title because her Son Jesus is God.”
2-5-1.why: Mother of God: Mary’s title because her Son Jesus is God.

2-5-1.q: Catechism 494: “At the announcement that she would give birth to "the Son of the Most High" without knowing man, by the power of the Holy Spirit, Mary responded with the _____ of faith, certain that "with God nothing will be impossible":”
2-5-1.why: CCC 494: “At the announcement that she would give birth to "the Son of the Most High" without knowing man, by the power of the Holy Spirit, Mary responded with the obedience of faith, certain that "with God nothing will be impossible":”

2-5-1.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Mary says yes” teaches? “Mary spoke to her at Lourdes.”
2-5-1.why: Bernadette: Mary spoke to her at Lourdes.

2-5-1.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Mary says yes”?
2-5-1.why: Luke 1:38 is the passage for this lesson.

2-5-2.q: True or false: Saints loved God in everyday ways. We can follow their examples.
Which word fits? “A holy person who is with God in heaven.”
2-5-2.why: saint: A holy person who is with God in heaven.

2-5-2.q: Which word fits? “The union of all God’s holy people: on earth, in purgatory and in heaven.”
2-5-2.why: communion of saints: The union of all God’s holy people: on earth, in purgatory and in heaven.

2-5-2.q: Catechism 2030: “he discovers it in the spiritual tradition and long history of the saints who have gone before him and whom the _____ celebrates in the rhythms of the sanctoral cycle.”
2-5-2.why: CCC 2030: “he discovers it in the spiritual tradition and long history of the saints who have gone before him and whom the liturgy celebrates in the rhythms of the sanctoral cycle.”

2-5-2.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Saints show the way” teaches? “Look up your baptismal saint or name saint.”
2-5-2.why: Your patron: look up your baptismal saint or name saint.

2-5-2.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Saints show the way”?
2-5-2.why: Hebrews 12:1-2 is the passage for this lesson.

2-5-3.q: True or false: Heaven is life with God forever. Jesus has prepared a place for us. We try to follow him there.
Which word fits? “Life with God forever, in perfect happiness.”
2-5-3.why: heaven: Life with God forever, in perfect happiness.

2-5-3.q: Which word fits? “Life with God that never ends.”
2-5-3.why: eternal life: Life with God that never ends.

2-5-3.q: Catechism 1026: “By his death and Resurrection, Jesus Christ has "opened" _____ to us.”
2-5-3.why: CCC 1026: “By his death and Resurrection, Jesus Christ has "opened" heaven to us.”

2-5-3.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Heaven is our home” teaches? “She said “Yes” to God even in illness.”
2-5-3.why: Bl. Chiara Badano: she said “Yes” to God even in illness.

2-5-3.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Heaven is our home”?
2-5-3.why: John 14:1-3 is the passage for this lesson.

2-6-1.q: True or false: The first three commandments teach us to love God: worship him alone, use his name with respect, keep Sunday holy.
Which word fits? “The ten laws God gave Moses that show how to love God and neighbor.”
2-6-1.why: Ten Commandments: The ten laws God gave Moses that show how to love God and neighbor.

2-6-1.q: Which word fits? “The day of rest and worship; for Christians, Sunday.”
2-6-1.why: Sabbath: The day of rest and worship; for Christians, Sunday.

2-6-1.q: Catechism 2083: “You shall not make for yourself a graven image, or any likeness of anything that is in _____ above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth;”
2-6-1.why: CCC 2083: “You shall not make for yourself a graven image, or any likeness of anything that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth;”

2-6-1.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Love God first” teaches? “He received the commandments.”
Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Love God first”?
2-6-1.why: Exodus 20:1-11 is the passage for this lesson.

2-6-2.q: True or false: The next commandments teach us to honor our parents, respect life and speak the truth.
Which word fits? “The ten laws God gave Moses that show how to love God and neighbor.”
2-6-2.why: Ten Commandments: The ten laws God gave Moses that show how to love God and neighbor.

2-6-2.q: Which word fits? “Listening to and following those who rightly guide us, as Jesus did.”
2-6-2.why: obedience: Listening to and following those who rightly guide us, as Jesus did.

2-6-2.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Honor your parents and respect life” teaches? “She gave her life for her child.”
2-6-2.why: Gianna Molla: she gave her life for her child.

2-6-2.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Honor your parents and respect life”?
2-6-2.why: Exodus 20:12-16 is the passage for this lesson.

2-6-3.q: True or false: The last commandments teach us to be pure of heart, not to steal and not to envy.
Which word fits? “The ten laws God gave Moses that show how to love God and neighbor.”
2-6-3.why: Ten Commandments: The ten laws God gave Moses that show how to love God and neighbor.

2-6-3.q: Which word fits? “Being thankful for gifts.”
Who is this saint, who lived what “Be grateful and content” teaches? “He embraced poverty and joy.”
2-6-3.why: Francis of Assisi: he embraced poverty and joy.

2-6-3.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Be grateful and content”?
2-6-3.why: Exodus 20:15,17 is the passage for this lesson.

2-7-1.q: True or false: The Our Father is the prayer Jesus taught. It has seven requests.
Which word fits? “The prayer Jesus taught us.”
2-7-1.why: Our Father: The prayer Jesus taught us.

2-7-1.q: Which word fits? “Asking God for what we need.”
2-7-1.why: petition: Asking God for what we need.

2-7-1.q: Catechism 2761: “The Lord's _____ "is truly the summary of the whole gospel." "Since the Lord .”
2-7-1.why: CCC 2761: “The Lord's Prayer "is truly the summary of the whole gospel." "Since the Lord .”

2-7-1.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Our Father” teaches? “She wrote about the Our Father.”
2-7-1.why: Teresa of Avila: she wrote about the Our Father.

2-7-1.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Our Father”?
2-7-1.why: Matthew 6:9-13 is the passage for this lesson.

2-7-2.q: True or false: We pray the Hail Mary, Glory Be, Apostles’ Creed and Act of Contrition. We memorize them to pray anywhere.
Which word fits? “Raising our minds and hearts to God.”
2-7-2.why: prayer: Raising our minds and hearts to God.

2-7-2.q: Which word fits? “A statement of what the Church believes.”
2-7-2.why: Creed: A statement of what the Church believes.

2-7-2.q: Catechism 2676: “This twofold movement of _____ to Mary has found a privileged expression in the Ave Maria:”
2-7-2.why: CCC 2676: “This twofold movement of prayer to Mary has found a privileged expression in the Ave Maria:”

2-7-2.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Prayers of the Church” teaches? “She loved simple prayers.”
Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Prayers of the Church”?
2-7-2.why: Luke 1:28 is the passage for this lesson.

2-7-3.q: True or false: We can pray in silence and listen to God. This is meditation.
Which word fits? “Raising our minds and hearts to God.”
2-7-3.why: prayer: Raising our minds and hearts to God.

2-7-3.q: Catechism 2708: “Christian _____ tries above all to meditate on the mysteries of Christ, as in lectio divina or the rosary.”
2-7-3.why: CCC 2708: “Christian prayer tries above all to meditate on the mysteries of Christ, as in lectio divina or the rosary.”

2-7-3.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Quiet time with God” teaches? “She pondered things in her heart.”
2-7-3.why: Mary: she pondered things in her heart.

2-7-3.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Quiet time with God”?
2-7-3.why: Psalm 46:10 is the passage for this lesson.

2-8-1.q: True or false: We prepare for Jesus’ birth and then celebrate it for many days.
Which word fits? “The season of preparing for Christmas.”
2-8-1.why: Advent: The season of preparing for Christmas.

2-8-1.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Advent and Christmas” teaches? “They waited and prepared.”
2-8-1.why: Mary and Joseph: they waited and prepared.

2-8-1.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Advent and Christmas”?
2-8-1.why: Luke 2:1-20 is the passage for this lesson.

2-8-2.q: True or false: In Lent we pray, fast and give. At Easter we celebrate that Jesus is alive.
Which word fits? “The forty days of prayer, fasting and almsgiving before Easter.”
2-8-2.why: Lent: The forty days of prayer, fasting and almsgiving before Easter.

2-8-2.q: Which word fits? “Giving to the poor out of love.”
2-8-2.why: almsgiving: Giving to the poor out of love.

2-8-2.q: Catechism 1169: “Therefore _____ is not simply one feast among others, but the "Feast of feasts," the "Solemnity of solemnities," just as the Eucharist is the "Sacrament of sacraments" (the Great Sacrament).”
2-8-2.why: CCC 1169: “Therefore Easter is not simply one feast among others, but the "Feast of feasts," the "Solemnity of solemnities," just as the Eucharist is the "Sacrament of sacraments" (the Great Sacrament).”

2-8-2.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Lent and Easter” teaches? “He lived simply.”
Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Lent and Easter”?
2-8-2.why: Matthew 6:1-18 is the passage for this lesson.

2-8-3.q: True or false: We celebrate feasts of Mary and the saints and holy days like All Saints.
Which word fits? “A special feast on which Catholics are bound to go to Mass.”
2-8-3.why: holy day of obligation: A special feast on which Catholics are bound to go to Mass.

2-8-3.q: Which word fits? “The Church’s year of seasons that retells the life of Christ.”
2-8-3.why: liturgical year: The Church’s year of seasons that retells the life of Christ.

2-8-3.q: Catechism 2043: “The fifth precept (“You shall observe the prescribed days of _____ and abstinence.") ensures the times of ascesis and penance which prepare us for the liturgical feasts;”
2-8-3.why: CCC 2043: “The fifth precept (“You shall observe the prescribed days of fasting and abstinence.") ensures the times of ascesis and penance which prepare us for the liturgical feasts;”

2-8-3.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Holy days and feasts” teaches? “They show many ways to love God.”
2-8-3.why: All the saints: they show many ways to love God.

2-8-3.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Holy days and feasts”?
2-8-3.why: Revelation 7:9-17 is the passage for this lesson.
